name: AgentRedTeam
summary: Stress-tests AI agents with adversarial scenarios and gives each one a trust score.
tags: Python · Gemini ADK · FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Docker · GCP
points: Scenarios cover prompt injection, contradictory instructions, missing data, role confusion and tool failures.
Each run is scored with rule-based checks plus an LLM judge.
Backend on FastAPI, PostgreSQL and GCP Cloud Run, with automated tests and CI/CD.

name: Hybrid Retrieval Service
summary: Retrieval for RAG that mixes meaning-based and keyword search to find the right passages.
points: Dense (FAISS) and sparse (BM25) results merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion: Precision@5 up 21% on 10,000 documents.
FastAPI service with sub-400 ms p95 latency.
Checks that answers are grounded in the retrieved passages.
